name: The Milk of Human Kindness
source:
A kinetic novel centered around the family life of two women, Brooke and Cecilia, who deal with a boob-loving baby among other things daily. Made for [url=http://theboobjam.com/]The Boob Jam[/url] of 2013.

[Edited from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=23467]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
